mcqs.q: In a balanced nuclear equation, what must be equal on both sides?
options: Energy has been converted into mass following E=mc^2.
Only the total mass in kilograms needs to balance.
Only the atomic number (proton count) needs to balance.
The total mass number (top numbers) and the total atomic number (bottom numbers) must both balance.

mcqs.q: Which type of nuclear radiation is most ionising?
options: Alpha radiation — large, doubly charged particles cause the most ionisation per unit distance.
Beta radiation is most ionising because it consists of fast electrons.
Gamma is most ionising because it can travel furthest and pass through almost anything.
Energy has been converted into mass following E=mc^2.

mcqs.q: When energy is 'lost' as heat due to friction, what has really happened?
options: Energy has been used up and no longer exists.
Only the total mass in kilograms needs to balance.
Energy has been transferred to the thermal store of the surroundings — it's not destroyed, just dissipated.
Energy has been converted into mass following E=mc^2.
